## Accepted root extractor fix

Integrated into `main` at **`4d32f19d4`** after independent review with no findings. The rebuilt DuckDB **2.0.0** extension is `/Users/kevintruong/project/SpurCode/docs/research/artifacts/2026-11-15-rust-macro-qualification-fix/build-4d32f19d4/spur_graph.duckdb_extension`, SHA256 **`be0548ce3a1217cf0b50110ad02419223c895daa8d2a932d7a81747da4c38892`**.

Validation: **77 native tests**, **31 real DuckDB tests**, **14 qualifier controls** in Rust execution **160**, and **66 independent native/SQL fixtures**. The 52 frozen source files preserve nodes, spans, macro invocations and macro scopes exactly. Real SpurCode `Vec::new()` stays recorded with scope `Vec` and target NULL; local constructors/helpers and internal-comment paths resolve in the controlled cases.

The retained managed SQL process still has the baseline extension loaded. Load the corrected artifact in a fresh DuckDB 2.0.0 process and re-ingest with a new extractor-version key to refresh cached facts. The historical whole-project 12.48% rate was not recomputed; this remains heuristic extraction without compiler macro expansion. Earlier candidate cells are retained as evidence of the regressions found during review.
